query: SELECT count(*) AS "n!" FROM businesses.business b WHERE b.id = $1 OR (NOT $3 AND b.status = 'active' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM businesses.job_type_choice c WHERE c.business_id = b.id AND c.category = $2)) OR ($3 AND b.status = 'waitlist' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM businesses.signup s WHERE s.business_id = b.id AND $2 = ANY (s.trades)))
